items.title: Investors rotate into tech stocks as inflation concerns ease: AlphaCheck
items.summary: Tech stocks reversed Monday's losses, buoyed by falling oil prices and Treasury yields.

items.title: Market Braces for Crunch Nvidia Earnings, PCE Report. Stock Futures Fall.
items.summary: Stock futures were heading for a negative open early Wednesday ahead of crunch earnings from chip maker Nvidia that will give a steer on artificial intelligence spending—a major headache for markets.  Nvidia will report after trading closes today.

items.title: 3 AI Networking Stocks Dominating a Quiet Niche
items.summary: AI accelerators steal the spotlight, but a quieter layer of the buildout is capturing an outsized share of the capex flowing into every new GPU cluster. Three networking stocks sit at that choke point, and each just raised its outlook.

items.title: Nvidia Earnings Give Investors a Barometer for State of AI Trade
items.summary: Wall Street is eagerly anticipating Nvidia Corp.'s earnings on Wednesday afternoon, not so much for what the numbers will say about the chip giant, but for what they mean to artificial intelligence investors and the market itself.

items.title: Nvidia Earnings, Inflation Data: What to Watch the Rest of the Week
items.summary: August is winding down, but there's still a lot left for markets to digest. Nvidia reports earnings after the bell today, following the latest inflation data this morning. Then, Kevin Warsh’s first major policy speech as Federal Reserve chairman follows on Friday.

items.title: Marvell Technology (MRVL) Reports Earnings Tomorrow: What To Expect
items.summary: Networking chips designer Marvell Technology (NASDAQ: MRVL) will be reporting earnings this Thursday after market hours. Here’s what you need to know.

items.title: How Google and Marvell’s Partnership Changes Everything
items.summary: Marvell recently issued Google a warrant for up to 58.97 million shares at an exercise price of $206.58 per share. Eric Bleeker and Austin Smith break down the partnership between the two companies, as well as what it could mean to the AI landscape as a whole.

items.title: What You Actually Pay To Join The AMD Run
items.summary: The chipmaker's long-term surge is powered by real AI demand, but a recent pullback and a steep valuation force investors to ask what's left in the tank.
